You fucked up big time. Or actually, the CLI reviewer fucked up big time because this is not a data list component:

orbit app:list renders an Apps heading followed by each app and indented Repository, Instances, and Workspaces property lines.

We have a Laravel prompts data list component, and that should be considered to be the data list component when it's mentioned. Tighten the CLI reviewer prompt and clearly document this in docs/ux. The data list component should refer to the Laravel Prompts component.

expectation: Protect Laravel Prompts datatable identity, literal app:list columns, selection drill-down, and reviewer vocabulary.

protection.rejected_example: app:list renders an Apps heading with each app followed by indented Repository:, Instances:, and Workspaces: property lines.
protection.accepted_example: app:list invokes Laravel\Prompts\datatable with Name, Repository, Instances, and Workspaces columns; selecting a row opens app:show.

expectation: Keep logical app inventory in the concrete Laravel Prompts datatable and open the placement drill-down from the selected row.

protection.rejected_example: app:list uses a custom component named DataList or grouped Repository:, Instances:, and Workspaces: property lines.
protection.accepted_example: app:list invokes Laravel\Prompts\datatable with Name, Repository, Instances, and Workspaces columns; selecting a row opens app:show with instance and workspace URLs.
